about: Pages with more than 1200 px of bare text at 1366 x 800 when the wall-of-text gate started (2026-11-01, issue #150), with the stretch measured then. The list only shrinks: break a page up and remove it, and lower "left". tools/test-walls.mjs enforces it. Safety notes are shown whole, never folded (tools/doc-page.mjs SHOWN_WHOLE), so the three that were walls stay here until they gain diagrams.
